text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: billing-metering anomaly detected in prod (token counting drift). Metric token_count_delta > 1000/min on several shards in us-east-1. Initiating live triage. Thread TS 1765439996
marco: I'm on it. seeing elevated token deltas from emitter-proxy around 18:03-18:07 UTC. scope looks limited to a subset of Kafka consumer shards.
lena: we're getting customer-facing overage flags for ~3% of active accounts. Support already ingested ~12 tickets, mostly SMB. A couple of mid-market accounts flagged invoices.
pranav: timeline + suspected cause? any known deploys or infra events?
marco: infra note: we had a small Kafka rebalance at 18:01 UTC. observables show retry spikes afterwards. suspect duplicate emission on retry > dedupe gap.
marco: logs snippet: ```WARN emitter: ack missing for payload=0x9f3b retry=1 shard=12
INFO emitter: queued retry payload=0x9f3b attempt=2
```
billing-bot: shadow_vs_live_diff: 1.8x on shard-12, 1.05x on most others. rolling median across shards up 1.2x.
lena: support asks whether we can pause overage alerts or mute automated billing emails briefly. I'd prefer to pause alerts for affected customers until we reconcile.
marco: proposing mitigation: deploy counting-service v2 hotfix with stronger idempotency and short-lived debounce at emitter layer. will also run targeted recon on affected shards.
marco: deploying now:
```
kubectl -n billing set image deploy/counting-service counting=redwood/counting:v2-hotfix-20260320
```
pranav: coordinate handoff: alex (night oncall) — can you take second-watch and be ready for escalation at 18:30 UTC? @alex
alex: taking it. I'll join watch at 18:30 and run the backfill plan if drift persists. ping me for escalation.
marco: hotfix rolled to 3/4 replicas. monitoring metrics: shard-12 delta reduced from 1.8x -> 1.25x in the last 4m. one shard still ~1.6x, investigating backlog.
lena: I'll create a short support template and pause automatic invoice generation for flagged accounts. drafting now :memo:
marco: running immediate recon script: `python ops/recon.py --since 2026-03-20T18:00Z --shards 12,13 --limit 1000`
billing-bot: realtime alert: emitter-ack-latency spiked to 3.2s after rebalance, ack-miss events correlated with retry count >1.
pranav: severity update? customer impact classification?
incident-bot: Update: severity -> S2 (moderate). Customer-visible overage flags present but no confirmed incorrect billing yet. Escalate to S1 if invoices are actually charged or enterprise accounts affected.
lena: copying CS and Billing Ops on the templated note; will attach list of impacted customers once recon completes.
marco: immediate follow-ups: 1) add ack idempotency at emitter 2) increase consumer backoff after rebalance 3) add metric emitter-ack-latency alert with shard granularity. I'll file PRs.
pranav: noted. creating incident ticket INC-20260320-47 and adding runbook references.
alex: I'll watch for 1h, start backfill at 18:50 UTC if deltas don't normalise. keep me posted.
lena: support template ready, sending to CS to review. will notify customers only after we confirm scope.
marco: thanks all. current status: hotfix deployed, partial mitigation seen, recon running. tagging follow-ups for postmortem. :white_check_mark:
